text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what it is, but I get the sense Mejiro Ardan isn't feeling herself today…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh… I see you can tell something's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Truthfully, I awoke with a mild headache this morning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's no cause for concern, though. I've experienced much worse than—Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your concern, Trainer. I shall see whether my condition improves before I resume training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan forces a smile, but the headache continues to bother her for some time.
